name: Christmas

text.trigger: A player with a survivor at the colony takes a search action.
text.vignette: Someone has tied scraps of foil to a coat rack and called it a tree. When an old cook asks if the stores can spare a real meal for one evening, the whole hall holds its breath.

options.hold-the-feast: Spend 5 food on a proper holiday supper: morale rises by 1. (Only possible with 5 food in the supply.)
options.keep-rationing: Stay on short rations. Nothing happens.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #15; the feast option is impossible below 5 food, which forces the other (R p12). OMITTED: the Forest Plum clause (the player who controls Forest draws up to 4 Grocery Store cards and hands them out) needs a hook; the trigger point is a stand-in for "a survivor you control is at the colony"
